To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the majority of the studies on feedback in the MENA region are qualitative in nature and focus on the teacher’s role.
The majority of studies in the region are conducted in Egypt, and that most studies focus on oral and written feedback.
the provision of feedback is a very complex and multifaceted issue, which is not only dependent on the type of the learning task but also on the type and level of proficiency of the learners.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the feedback provided by teachers to learners in EFL classrooms.
feedback as an instructional practice that is used to help students improve their learning.
the role of feedback as an instructional practice in the English language teaching (ELT) context in the MENA region.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
feedback is the information which is provided in a learning environment, in order to assess the performance of a learner and improve his/her performance in order to reach the learning targets.
feedback is a process in which information is provided to a learner by a teacher or a peer in order to improve the performance of the learner.
feedback is the information which is provided by a teacher or any other source to a learner or group of learners in order to assess a certain performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
feedback is a process of interaction which aims at helping the learner improve his/her performance and understanding.
feedback is the information that is provided to a learner by an agent such that the learner can assess his/her performance and understand the target of learning.
feedback is the information given to learners in order to help them to improve their performance and understanding of a learning task.
The main takeaway from our work is that
feedback is an integral part of the teaching/learning process and that its provision is a complex task.
feedback is a crucial component of the learning process and that it should be provided in all educational contexts.
feedback is a powerful tool in the hands of teachers and that its use is not as straightforward as it may appear.
